system.description:
When you **_cast a spell learned from the Hec’tumel Codex_**, roll +INT: **on a 10+**, the spell works as described; **on a 7-9**, the spell works, but choose 1 from the list below; **on a 6-**, mark a consequence (see reverse) in addition to whatever the GM says.
- You draw unwelcome attention or put yourself in a spot (ask the GM how)
- Something shifts in your mind; take a -1 penalty to Cast a Codex Spell until you get Hec’tumel to show you what you’re doing wrong (the penalty is cumulative)

partial.value: the spell works, but choose 1 from the list below

failure.value: mark a consequence (see reverse) in addition to whatever the GM says.
